recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up core-spec work is needed for FHIR-37990 unless FHIR-I later changes token syntax for id-valued search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-37990 requested that token search parameter documentation extend the existing ContactPoint, uri, and boolean no-pipe syntax restriction to id-valued targets because _id is defined as a token parameter over logical ids.
initial_application: Commit 7f8767e5b763626bfd9bbb9ed4952fcec9acb325 explicitly applied FHIR-37990 by updating source/search.html to list ids alongside ContactPoint, uri, and boolean and to forbid pipe syntax for token parameters on id elements.
additional_context: FHIR-14237 established the earlier no-pipe rule for ContactPoint, uri, and boolean. FHIR-13320 is background for _id token semantics and case sensitivity. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-08-29 corroborate the Persuasive 15-0-0 vote, and bounded Zulip/Confluence/Jira searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/search.html already says ids are token targets where the URI/system portion is not used and its conformance note says token parameters on id, ContactPoint, uri, or boolean SHALL NOT use the pipe symbol.

related_jiras.note: Established the prior no-pipe token restriction for ContactPoint, uri, and boolean that FHIR-37990 extends to id.
Clarified _id token case-sensitivity semantics and explains why _id-specific token behavior was already documented elsewhere.
